description: Source code for HTTP upload functionality in the Google Breakpad project, handling HTTP requests, response reading, multipart form-data generation, and file content handling on Windows.

classes.name: HTTPUpload::AutoInternetHandle
classes.description: Helper class managing automatic closing of Windows internet handles.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::SendRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends an HTTP POST request with multipart form data, handles response code and body.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads the response data from an HTTP request, handling content length and data availability.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::GenerateMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Generates a unique multipart boundary string for form-data.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::GenerateRequestHeader
methods.description: Creates the Content-Type header with boundary for multipart/form-data.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::GenerateRequestBody
methods.description: Builds the multipart request body with parameters and files.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::GetFileContents
methods.description: Reads file contents into a byte vector, supporting wide filenames.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::UTF8ToWide
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to wide string.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::WideToMBCP
methods.description: Converts wide string to multibyte string with specified code page.

methods.name: HTTPUpload::CheckParameters
methods.description: Validates parameter names for allowed characters.
